mapper.select: SELECT cur.tr_ymd AS "trYmd" , cur.tr_cd AS "trCd" , cur.balh_co AS "balhCo" , cur.jeungj_mth AS "jeungjMth" , cur.baej_mth AS "baejMth" , cur.balh_ga AS "balhGa" , cur.woos_balh_ga AS "woosBalhGa" , cur.jekyng_rt AS "jekyngRt" , cur.woos_jekyng_rt AS "woosJekyngRt" , cur.baed_gisan_ymd AS "baedGisanYmd" , cur.cheng_ymd AS "chengYmd" , cur.krak_ymd AS "krakYmd" , cur.baej_gijun_ymd AS "baejGijunYmd" , cur.jukm_nabib_ymd AS "jukmNabibYmd" , cur.sinj_jaew AS "sinjJaew" , cur.ilban_balh_jusu AS "ilbanBalhJusu" , cur.woos_balh_jusu AS "woosBalhJusu" , f_balh_nm('', cur.balh_co) AS "xxBalhCo" , prev.baej_mth AS "jkBaejMth" , prev.balh_ga AS "jkBalhGa" , prev.jekyng_rt AS "jkJekyngRt" , NULL AS "closeYmd" FROM sjt0jk cur LEFT JOIN sjt0jk prev ON prev.balh_co = cur.balh_co AND prev.tr_cd = CASE WHEN #{trCd} = 'G32' THEN 'G31' ELSE 'G35' END WHERE cur.tr_cd = #{trCd} ORDER BY cur.tr_ymd DESC
